content.title: Where to watch Phillies vs. Braves on Sunday Night Baseball: Time, live stream details
content.text: Ronald Acuña Jr., Atlanta Braves.APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Philadelphia Phillies set out to avoid a fifth straight loss and a series sweep by the Atlanta Braves with a Sunday night series finale at Citizens Bank Park. The game is scheduled to start at 7:20 p.m. ET with streaming exclusively on Peacock, which starts at $10.99 per month.How to watch: The Phillies vs. Braves game will stream exclusively on Peacock, which is available for $10.99 per month, or less if paying on an annual basis.Peacock will be the exclusive home of MLB’s “Sunday Night Baseball” throughout the 2026 season.The Phillies are 2-8 over their past 10 games to slide to 8-12 on the season with recent series losses to the San Francisco Giants, Arizona Diamondbacks, Chicago Cubs and Braves. Thus far in two matchups with Atlanta, the Phillies offense has gone silent with one total run scored. And over the course of their current four-game losing streak, the Phils have been outscored 33-7 by the Cubs and Braves.Atlanta Braves at Philadelphia PhilliesMLB matchup at a glanceWhen: Sunday, April 19 at 7:20 p.m. ETWhere: Citizens Bank Park, Philadelphia, Pa.TV channel: N/ALive stream: Peacock exclusive ($10.99+/mo.)The Phillies will give the ball to right-hander Andrew Painter (1-0, 3.77 ERA) to try and avoid the sweep. He will face Braves righty Grant Holmes (1-1, 3.32 ERA) in a matchup where the hosts are slim betting favorites (-112) over the Braves (-108). After Sunday’s game, more of the same lies in the future with Philadelphia set to visit the Cubs and Braves on a seven-game road trip set to begin Monday night in Chicago. What is Peacock?Peacock is the streaming home of all content from NBC Universal, including live and replay sports offerings from NBC and other networks. The sports content on Peacock includes Major League Baseball, Big Ten football, the English Premier League, the NFL’s “Sunday Night Football,” World Wrestling Entertainment, and more.More on Peacock’s pricingPremium ($10.99/mo.): Includes new and hit shows and Peacock originals, live sports and events, current NBC and Bravo shows, and 50+ always-on channels.Premium Plus ($16.99/month): All features from Premium, plus ad-free content, the ability to download select titles, and access to your local NBC channel 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.Annual plans: Priced annually, the Premium plan costs $109.99 or 12 months for the price of 10. The Premium Plus plan costs $169.99 per year.
